class.name: JustAMCPMCPClientBridge
class.brief_description: MCP tools for bridging to remote MCP servers.
class.description: Host for outbound Streamable HTTP MCP clients. Lists, adds, updates, and removes [code]mcp_clients[/code] entries, connects bridges (discover or legacy initialize), and forwards tools, prompts, resources, and completions to allow-listed remote endpoints. Secrets such as [code]auth_token[/code] and [code]client_secret[/code] are redacted from list results.

method.name: add_bridge
method.description: Adds a bridge. [param args] must include [code]name[/code] and [code]url[/code]. Optional fields include [code]protocol_version[/code], [code]auth_token[/code], [code]oauth_mode[/code], [code]auto_connect[/code], and [code]expose_remote_tools[/code].

method.name: auto_connect_enabled_bridges
method.description: Connects every enabled bridge that has [code]auto_connect[/code] set.

method.name: connect_bridge
method.description: Connects the bridge named in [param args].

method.name: disconnect_bridge
method.description: Disconnects the named bridge and clears its session cache.

method.name: execute_tool
method.description: Executes the MCP client-bridge tool named by [param tool_name] with [param arguments] and returns the tool response dictionary.

method.name: list_bridges
method.description: Lists configured bridges with [code]auth_token[/code] and [code]client_secret[/code] redacted.

method.name: provide_tool_schemas
method.description: Returns MCP JSON schema dictionaries for client-bridge tools. Set [param register_only] for registration metadata only, or [param ignore_settings] to bypass editor filtering.

method.name: remove_bridge
method.description: Removes the bridge named in [param args].

method.name: status_bridge
method.description: Returns connection status for the named bridge.

method.name: update_bridge
method.description: Updates fields on an existing bridge. [param args] must include [code]name[/code].
